usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a coherent, well-sourced picture of Amon: Brazilian engineer, UNICAMP 1992, joined Qualcomm as an engineer (1995 per several sources, 1996 per Wikipedia — flagged as contested), CTO at Vesper, president in 2018, CEO since June 2021, plus his strategy (diversification beyond handsets, Nuvia/Oryon CPUs, automotive, edge AI, data-center targets) and recognition (Time 100 AI, 2025). A reader clearly learns who he is and what he has done, and could prepare talking points for a meeting from the strategy and earnings-call material. Epistemic signaling is partial: claimed/contested/unknown statuses and the conflicting 1995/1996 start dates are surfaced, but the dossier never explicitly states what it does not know or what topics are uncovered. The main defects are a cluster of claims built on a DataCite deposit record that explicitly carries 'no identifier' and 'no affiliation' — the dossier treats role and company strings listed as co-creators as facts about Amon — plus a few statements outrunning their quoted passages.
